jurisdictions.name: Andorra

authority.name: Government of Andorra

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors need an Andorran fishing licence. A managed fishing area also requires its own acotat permit, including areas where you must release the catch.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors who fish in rivers or lakes.

extras.name: Acotat catch-and-release permit
extras.when: Required in a designated catch-and-release area, in addition to the licence.

extras.name: Intensive acotat permit
extras.when: Required in an intensive fishing area; the listed permit allows four catches.

keyRules: Carry the acotat permit when you fish in a managed area.
Use a single barbless artificial hook in catch-and-release areas.
Use a landing net and return fish alive immediately in catch-and-release areas.
Check the official map for the season of each water.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use Pesca en línia, a fishing shop, or a local tourism office.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the permit package for a guided trip. Tourist child prices differ from resident child prices.

jurisdictions.name: Austria

authority.name: Austrian public service portal; provincial fisheries authorities

jurisdictions.summary: Austria normally requires a provincial fishing card or guest card, plus permission for the chosen water. Rules differ between the nine provinces, so one province's card is not a countrywide permit.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors normally need the fishing documents required by the province and the water-right holder.
exemptions: Vienna: children aged 6–13 can fish under an authorised adult's supervision if the adult's permit records their permission.

extras.name: Water-right holder's licence
extras.when: Normally required in addition to the provincial fishing card or guest card.

keyRules: Vienna guest cards cover only the waters named on the card.
In Vienna, carry the fishing card and show official photo ID when requested.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Ask the provincial fisheries authority about the card. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-right holder; Vienna rights holders also issue guest cards.

sources.title: Fishing requirements in the nine provinces
Vienna fishing cards and guest cards

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the province's visitor qualifications, prices, child rules and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Belgium

authority.name: Regional fisheries authorities; Walloon Public Service

jurisdictions.summary: Freshwater permits differ between Flanders, Wallonia and Brussels. In Wallonia, most rivers outside the public navigable waterways also require a club card or the fishing-right holder's permission.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in Wallonia's rivers, canals and connected lakes need a Walloon permit.
Use the separate regional system for Flanders or Brussels.
exemptions: Wallonia: isolated ponds without natural fish passage to a river do not require the regional permit.

extras.name: Wallonia club card or owner's permission
extras.when: Required outside the public navigable waterways when the water belongs to a club or another fishing-right holder.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Sea fishing has separate coastal rules. RecFishing reports are required for the specified sea bass, bluefin tuna and European eel catches.
keyRules: In Wallonia, carry the permit and valid ID.
Choose a permit that covers bank, boat, wading or night fishing as applicable.
Follow the official RecFishing reporting rules for the listed marine species.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy the Walloon permit online at permisdepeche.be. Use the relevant regional authority for Flanders or Brussels.

sources.title: Belgian coastal rules and 2026 catch registration

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current regional prices, child rules, coastal requirements and guide coverage. The purchase link serves Wallonia only.

jurisdictions.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina

authority.name: Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina inspection authority; local fishing-right holders

jurisdictions.summary: In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, anglers need a permit for the fishing area or zone. Buy it from that area's fishing-right holder; another area's permit works only where an agreement allows it.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors who fish Federation freshwater fishing areas or zones.
exemptions: The cited Federation law exempts foreign citizens from its fishing-exam requirement, but they still need a permit.

extras.name: Fishing-area or zone permit
extras.when: Buy from the fishing-right holder for the chosen water; it provides local access.

keyRules: Carry the permit for the area where you fish.
Check that any right to fish another area appears on the permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the fishing-right holder for the exact river or lake.

sources.title: Federation freshwater fisheries law, Articles 19 and 24

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current rules with the local authority. Republika Srpska, Brčko, national parks, coastal rules, prices and guide coverage need separate checks.

jurisdictions.name: Bulgaria

authority.name: Executive Agency for Fisheries and Aquaculture (IARA)

jurisdictions.summary: For inland recreational fishing, obtain an IARA ticket. Check access with the manager of your chosen water; the national ticket does not settle private-water access.
whoNeedsOne: Inland recreational anglers need the applicable IARA ticket.
keyRules: Use the ticket issued in your own name.
Follow the closed seasons and permitted fishing methods for the water.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Create an account on the IARA public portal, or apply through an IARA regional office.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current euro prices, foreign-passport registration, child exemptions, Black Sea rules, local-water charges and guide coverage with IARA.

jurisdictions.name: Croatia

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors need the appropriate freshwater or sea fishing licence. Freshwater licences cover named fishing zones, and the local rights holder adds its own management charges.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater sport anglers need the licence sold by the fishing-right holder.
Sea anglers need the applicable marine recreational or sport licence.

options.name: Freshwater day licence: state fee only
Freshwater three-day licence: state fee only
Freshwater seven-day licence: state fee only

extras.name: Freshwater rights-holder management charge
extras.when: Required with every freshwater licence; the local holder sets the charge.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Sea licences use a separate system. A recreational sea licence does not allow spearfishing.
keyRules: Use the freshwater licence only in its named zone or an agreed reciprocal zone.
An annual freshwater licence requires exam evidence and membership.
The freshwater day licence ends at midnight.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy freshwater licences through the fishing-right holder. Buy recreational sea licences from the ministry's online shop.

sources.title: Freshwater sport fishing: current Croatian guidance
Marine recreational and sport fishing rules 2026

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current marine exemptions, catch-report duties, special-species permits and charter coverage. Freshwater prices exclude local charges.

jurisdictions.name: Cyprus

authority.name: Department of Fisheries and Marine Research

jurisdictions.summary: Reservoir anglers need a dam licence, while marine boat and speargun fishing use separate licences. A dam licence covers only reservoirs that the department opens for fishing.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in licensed reservoirs.
Marine boat anglers and speargun users under the department's licence system.
exemptions: Ordinary marine hook-and-line fishing from shore does not use the boat or speargun licence.

options.name: Single-dam licence
options.duration: Until 31 December of the issue year

options.name: All-dams licence
options.duration: Until 31 December of the issue year

options.name: Marine vessel fishing licence
options.duration: Until 31 December of the issue year

options.name: Speargun licence
options.duration: Until 31 December of the issue year

jurisdictions.saltwater: Shore hook-and-line fishing differs from licensed boat and speargun fishing. Protected areas and gear limits still apply.
keyRules: Print the payment receipt; it serves as the licence.
Carry the licence and ID.
Use only a boat declared for the current licence year.
Do not fish in designated bathing areas.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply through the DFMR service. After approval, use the SMS payment link to JCC and print the receipt.

sources.title: Apply and pay for a recreational fishing licence

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm child eligibility, current reservoir openings and charter-client coverage. These sources cover the Republic of Cyprus system.

jurisdictions.name: Czechia

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture; municipal licensing offices

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors need a Czech fishing licence and a permit for the fishing ground. The 30-day licence needs no proof of fishing qualifications, but it does not include access to a river or lake.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors who fish regulated fishing grounds.

extras.name: Fishing-ground permit (povolenka)
extras.when: Required in addition to the state fishing licence for the chosen ground.

keyRules: Obtain the separate ground permit before you fish.
For longer licences, provide accepted qualification evidence; an equivalent foreign fishing licence can qualify.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply at the competent municipal office for your place of stay. Obtain the ground permit from its fishing-right holder.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the municipal fee, accepted ID, local catch-record requirements, child rules and guide coverage.

jurisdictions.name: Denmark

authority.name: Danish Agricultural and Fisheries Agency

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 18 up to the applicable state-pension age normally need the national angling licence. Some freshwater sites also charge for access, so check the water permit separately.
whoNeedsOne: Rod anglers aged 18 until the applicable state-pension age.
exemptions: Anglers under 18.
Anglers who reach the applicable state-pension age.

extras.name: Local water permit
extras.when: Required at waters where the rights holder charges for access.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The national rod licence also covers sea angling; it is not a separate freshwater-only licence.
keyRules: Carry your fishing number or payment receipt and personal ID.
Select the rod-angling licence; nets and traps use a different licence.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use fisketegn.dk and select that you do not live in Denmark for the visitor form.

sources.title: Official guidance: carrying a licence and ID

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm pension-age eligibility, any private-lake exemption, local access fees and guide coverage.

jurisdictions.name: Estonia

authority.name: Environmental Board (Keskkonnaamet)

jurisdictions.summary: Most recreational tackle requires paid fishing rights. One simple hand line is free on public waters, but selected rivers, protected areas and methods require a special fishing card.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers who use spinning, fly or other chargeable line tackle.
Anglers who fish specified special waters or use methods that require a fishing card.
exemptions: One simple hand line on public waters: one hook, natural bait and a line no longer than 1.5 rod lengths.

extras.name: Special fishing card (kalastuskaart)
extras.when: Required for specified salmon or trout rivers, named protected waters, crayfish and certain nets or traps.

extras.name: Private owner's permission
extras.when: Required on private waters that are not designated for public use.

keyRules: Paid ordinary recreational rights allow up to three line-fishing gears.
Do not sell the recreational catch.
Follow species, season and area restrictions even with the free hand-line right.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy recreational rights or apply for a special card through kalaluba.ee.

sources.title: Fishing rights and special fishing cards

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the price, duration, coastal classification, personal exemptions and guide coverage for your exact trip.

jurisdictions.name: Finland

authority.name: Metsähallitus

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 18–69 normally pay the fisheries management fee for lure fishing. It permits one rod in most mainland waters, but special waters and multiple rods require the water owner's permit too.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 18–69 who use lures or traps, or catch crayfish, subject to the age exemption.
exemptions: People under 18 or aged 70 and over do not pay the national fee.
People who reached 65 by 31 December 2023 remain exempt.
Simple hook-and-line angling and ice fishing are generally free outside restricted waters.

extras.name: Water-owner permit
extras.when: Required for multiple rods, traps, crayfish and applicable special waters, even when age exempts you from the national fee.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The mainland permit system includes coastal waters. Åland has a separate system.
keyRules: The national fee does not cover migratory-fish rapids or currents.
Check restrictions before you choose the water.
Daily and weekly fee periods begin and end at midnight.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use Eräluvat.fi, call +358 20 69 2424, or use an official sales point.

sources.title: Fisheries management fee and water-owner permits

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm special-water access, required catch reports and guide arrangements. Check Åland rules separately.

jurisdictions.name: France

authority.name: French public service; approved angling associations

jurisdictions.summary: Freshwater anglers need a carte de pêche valid for their chosen water. The card proves association membership and payment of required contributions, but access still depends on fishing rights and local agreements.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in freshwater where fish can pass naturally between connected waters.
exemptions: The national card requirement does not apply to legally closed waters.
The card is not compulsory on the annual fishing-promotion day, the first Sunday in June.

extras.name: Water-right holder's permission
extras.when: Required for the water; check which association waters and reciprocal agreements your card includes.

extras.name: Bluefin tuna authorisation
extras.when: Required for recreational bluefin tuna fishing under the marine rules.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Marine fishing follows separate rules. Registration and catch reports depend on the sea area and species, using RecFishing or the required local system.
keyRules: Use a freshwater card valid for the actual fishing sector.
Follow local seasons and tackle rules.
Do not sell the marine recreational catch.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy the freshwater card through cartedepeche.fr or an approved association. Use the maritime authority's service for marine authorisations.

sources.title: Freshwater angling licence and fishing rights

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the card's current price and duration, any salmon supplement, marine registration for your target species, and guide coverage.

jurisdictions.name: Germany

authority.name: State fisheries authorities; Berlin Fisheries Office

jurisdictions.summary: Choose the state before you arrange your fishing documents. In Berlin, you need both a fishing licence and a water permit; a tourist licence does not provide access to every water.
whoNeedsOne: Berlin anglers need a Fischereischein and an Angelkarte.
In Bavaria, foreign visitors can apply for a tourist licence under the visitor rules.

extras.name: Water permit (Angelkarte)
extras.when: Required alongside the fishing licence in Berlin; obtain the permit for your chosen water.

keyRules: In Berlin, carry both the fishing licence and water permit.
Bavarian visitor applicants must show credible proof of permission to fish in their home country.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply to the state's local licensing authority. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-right holder.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm your state's visitor qualifications, fee, coastal rules, age exemptions and guide coverage. These examples are not countrywide licence terms.

jurisdictions.name: Greece

authority.name: Hellenic Coast Guard

jurisdictions.summary: The Coast Guard does not require an ordinary personal or boat licence for recreational sea fishing. Gear, species and area limits still apply, and the boat's flag can affect whether you may fish.
exemptions: Ordinary recreational marine fishing does not require the former personal or boat fishing licence.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The Coast Guard confirms no ordinary recreational sea licence. This exemption does not remove protected-species or vessel-nationality restrictions.
keyRules: Do not assume a foreign-flag boat can fish; check the Coast Guard's nationality restrictions.
Release an accidentally caught live bluefin tuna immediately.
The ordinary sea catch limit is 5 kg per angler per 24 hours, with stated gear and single-fish exceptions.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: No ordinary sea licence purchase is required. Ask the local Port Authority about the planned method and boat.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm inland-water permissions, local closures, the May restriction for your method, current registration duties and charter-client requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Hungary

authority.name: Hungarian National Anglers' Association (MOHOSZ)

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors need a state fishing document and a territorial permit for the chosen water. The 90-day tourist state ticket requires an online knowledge test and only works with a compatible tourist territorial permit.
whoNeedsOne: Hungarian and foreign anglers must register in HORINFO.
Tourist-ticket holders also need the selected water's tourist territorial permit.
exemptions: The tourist state-ticket route does not require club membership or a Hungarian fishing card.

extras.name: Tourist territorial permit
extras.when: Required with the tourist state ticket for the selected water.

keyRules: Pass the online basic-knowledge test before you buy the tourist state ticket.
Use only one fishing rig under the tourist-ticket system.
Follow the tourist permit's lower catch limits.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Register and buy through horgaszjegy.hu, or use an authorised sales point.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the water's tourist-permit price, catch-log duties and the documents included in a guided trip.

jurisdictions.name: Iceland

authority.name: Directorate of Fisheries; Environment Agency; fishing-right holders

jurisdictions.summary: For rivers and lakes, obtain permission from the fishing-right holder before you fish. A permit covers the agreed water, while personal sea angling uses a different licence exemption.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers need permission from the landowner, fishing club or other rights holder.
exemptions: Personal-consumption sea fishing with rods or hand lines without automatic equipment needs no fishing permit.

extras.name: River or lake permit
extras.when: Obtain from the owner of the fishing rights for the specific water.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Personal-consumption sea angling is permit-free with approved hand gear. Respect land access and do not sell the catch.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Sea-tour operators need a permit for each vessel. The permit type sets catch and reporting conditions; confirm the trip's arrangements with the operator.
keyRules: Disinfect fishing equipment previously used abroad before use in Iceland.
Obtain freshwater permission before you fish.
Do not sell fish caught under the personal-consumption sea exemption.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy the freshwater permit from the fishing-right holder or its authorised seller.

sources.title: Marine personal fishing and tourism-vessel permits

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm local prices, seasons, child rules and any documents clients need on a guided freshwater trip.

jurisdictions.name: Ireland

authority.name: Inland Fisheries Ireland

jurisdictions.summary: A state licence is required for salmon and sea trout. Most waters also require permission or a fishery permit; the state licence does not provide access.
whoNeedsOne: Anyone who fishes for salmon or sea trout needs a state licence.
exemptions: No state licence is required for ordinary trout, coarse fish or other sea fish. Local permits can still apply.

options.name: Salmon and sea trout, one day
Salmon and sea trout, all districts
Salmon and sea trout, all districts

extras.name: Fishery permit
extras.when: For waters where the holder of the fishing rights requires a permit.

extras.name: Midland Fisheries permit
extras.when: For trout, pike and coarse fish in the controlled Midland Fisheries waters.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary sea angling needs no state licence. Salmon and sea trout still require a state licence.
keyRules: Check whether the salmon river is open for harvest, catch and release, or closed.
Tag retained salmon and sea trout over 40 cm as required by the tagging scheme.
Complete the salmon catch logbook.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy salmon licences from the IFI online shop or authorised tackle shops. Obtain the water permit from the fishery.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Check the fishery permit and guide arrangements. Loughs Agency waters use a separate system.

jurisdictions.name: Italy

authority.name: Regional fisheries authorities; Lombardy and Veneto

jurisdictions.summary: Freshwater licence procedures depend on the region. A regional licence does not replace the extra permit for water managed by a club or other concession holder.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors must meet the licence rules of the region where they fish.
Foreign visitors can obtain a Lombardy type B licence through the regional fee payment.

options.name: Veneto type D for foreign visitors

extras.name: Concession water permit
extras.when: In Veneto waters managed by a fishing association or another concession holder.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Veneto's official guidance directs sea anglers to the free national MASAF registration, with a separate procedure for foreign nationals.
keyRules: In Lombardy, carry the licence payment receipt and an identity document.
In Veneto concession waters, carry the manager's valid permit.
Check the rules for the region and water before the trip.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the regional payment service for the licence. Buy a concession permit from the water manager.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: The option shown is for Lombardy. Check other regional fees, visitor exemptions, sea registration and charter requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Latvia

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors normally need the national angling card. Water with a licensed fishery also requires its own fishing licence.
whoNeedsOne: Latvian and foreign anglers aged 16 and above, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 16, people over 65 and people with a disability do not need the national card. They must show proof when asked.

extras.name: Licensed-water permit
extras.when: For water subject to a separate licensed-fishing scheme, in addition to the national card.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The national angling rules include the sea. Check the rules for the location and species.
keyRules: Obtain both documents before fishing in a licensed fishery.
Carry proof of an age or disability exemption.
Check the card's end date; longer cards do not extend beyond the calendar year.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy an electronic card at makskeresanaskarte.lv with a payment card or internet banking. Confirmation arrives by email or SMS.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Check local permit exemptions and guide requirements with the fishery.

jurisdictions.name: Lithuania

authority.name: Environmental Protection Department and Ministry of Environment

jurisdictions.summary: Choose the permit for the water: a general state-water ticket, a leased-water permit, or a limited-fishery card. A general ticket does not cover every lake or special salmon fishery.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers need the permit category for their chosen water unless a statutory exemption applies.
exemptions: Children under 18, social insurance pensioners and people with a disability can qualify for free fishing. Carry the required proof.

extras.name: Leased-water permit
extras.when: Choose this permit for the specific leased water instead of relying on the general ticket.

extras.name: Limited-fishery card
extras.when: For waters or fisheries with a limited-fishing scheme.

keyRules: Use the permit category for the specific water.
Carry an identity document and the permit or electronic permit number.
Keep proof if you use a free-fishing entitlement.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use ALIS or authorised outlets such as Perlas and Maxima. Another person can buy for a foreign visitor with their name and birth date.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Check whether foreign pension or disability documents qualify. Confirm sea, limited-fishery and guide rules before the trip.

jurisdictions.name: Luxembourg

authority.name: Guichet.lu and Water Management Administration

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 14 and above need an inland fishing permit. Private category 2 waters also require the owner's written permission; border waters have a separate permit system.
whoNeedsOne: People aged 14 and above who fish in inland waters.
exemptions: Children under 14 can fish without a permit with one hand-held line or fly rod.

extras.name: Private-water written permission
extras.when: For category 2 waters, in addition to the inland permit.

keyRules: Carry the permit and an identity document.
Carry the owner's written permission for private water.
Choose special A for category 1 bank fishing or special B for boat fishing there.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply and pay through MyGuichet.lu without an account, or buy from the listed permit offices.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Check the separate border-water permit and local rules. Guide coverage is not confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Malta

authority.name: Department of Fisheries and Aquaculture

jurisdictions.summary: Ordinary hook-and-line fishing is exempt from the general fishing licence under Malta's regulations. The exemption does not open closed areas or remove special gear restrictions.
whoNeedsOne: People who use methods outside the listed licence exemptions need the Director's licence.
exemptions: Hook-and-line fishing, including jigging, is exempt from the general licence, subject to the area restrictions.

extras.name: Dockyard or French Creek licence
extras.when: For fishing in these restricted harbour areas where the regulations require a special licence.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The ordinary hook-and-line licence exemption applies at sea. Restricted places and methods still have separate conditions.
keyRules: Do not fish in closed or prohibited areas.
Check the special licence rule before fishing in Dockyard or French Creek.
A licence is personal and cannot be transferred.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the Department of Fisheries and Aquaculture for methods or areas that require a licence.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current species permits, catch reporting, boat and charter requirements. No general online purchase route is confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Monaco

authority.name: Direction des Affaires Maritimes

jurisdictions.summary: Shore anglers must declare their activity to Maritime Affairs. The current Sea Code requires renewal every three years, and fishing is restricted to authorised shore areas.
whoNeedsOne: People who fish with a line from the shore must make the declaration.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The shore declaration is not confirmation of permission to fish from a boat. Separate sea rules apply to other methods.
keyRules: Use no more than two hooks from the shore.
Fish only in authorised shore areas.
Do not sell the catch.
Return undersized fish, even if dead.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Submit the shore fishing declaration to the Direction des Affaires Maritimes.

sources.title: Shore declaration renewal every three years

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the declaration fee, submission route, and boat or charter requirements. Older pages may state an annual renewal.

jurisdictions.name: Montenegro

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management

jurisdictions.summary: A valid permit is required for recreational fishing in both freshwater and the sea. Freshwater permits come from the water user or protected-area manager, so buy for the chosen water.
whoNeedsOne: Recreational anglers in freshwater and marine waters need the relevant permit.

extras.name: Protected-area fishing permit
extras.when: For water managed by a protected-area authority; obtain its permit for that area.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Marine permits are separate and depend on the activity, such as shore, boat or underwater fishing.
keyRules: Carry the valid permit while fishing.
Observe the permitted sizes and closed seasons.
Do not sell fish caught under a recreational marine permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain freshwater permits from the water manager. Contact the ministry or an authorised issuer for marine permits.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current fees, the exact water coverage, visitor exemptions and guide requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Netherlands

authority.name: Government of the Netherlands

jurisdictions.summary: Most inland fishing requires a VISpas or another valid written permission. Club membership normally includes the VISpas, but it covers only the waters listed for that pass.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in most inland waters need the applicable fishing permission.

extras.name: Permission for other water
extras.when: For water outside the list covered by your VISpas.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Marine anglers aged 14 and above must register in RecFishing, even if they hold a VISpas. Separate marine gear and catch rules apply.
keyRules: Check the permitted water in VISplanner and the list linked to your pass.
Follow the conditions for your permit and chosen water.
Report sea bass, bluefin tuna and European eel catches in RecFishing within 24 hours, including released fish.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy a VISpas online or join an affiliated angling club. The government also describes a more limited Kleine VISpas.

sources.title: VISpas information from the permit issuer
Marine registration and catch reports in 2026

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current club fees, youth conditions, night or extra-rod permissions, and charter requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Norway

authority.name: Norwegian Environment Agency and Directorate of Fisheries

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 18 and above need the national fee payment for salmon, sea trout and migratory Arctic char in rivers and lakes. They also need the local water permit; ordinary freshwater fish require the local permission without that national fee.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 18 and above who fish for migratory salmonids in freshwater must pay the national fee.
Freshwater anglers must obtain the water owner's permission.
exemptions: Anglers under 18 do not pay the national fishing fee. Local permission can still be required.

extras.name: Local fishing licence
extras.when: For the chosen river or lake, including when the national salmon fee is required.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary recreational sea angling does not require a fishing licence. Foreign visitors must use hand-held tackle and must not sell the catch.
keyRules: Stay at least 100 metres from fish farms when fishing.
Observe sea-fish minimum sizes.
In 2026, tourists may export up to 15 kg of sea fish twice a year only through a registered tourist-fishing business.
The export allowance requires the visitor to be at least 12 and carry the required documentation.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Pay the national fee on the Environment Agency portal. Obtain the local licence from the owner or fishery.

sources.title: Rules for fishing in rivers and lakes

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm national fee prices, local youth conditions, salmon closures and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Poland

authority.name: Polish Waters and marine fisheries authorities

jurisdictions.summary: Foreign visitors who stay temporarily in Poland are exempt from the inland angler's card. They still need the permit for the chosen water; the exemption does not provide free access.
whoNeedsOne: Temporary foreign visitors need the water user's inland permit.
Sea anglers must meet the separate marine fee requirements.
exemptions: Foreign nationals who stay temporarily in Poland do not need the karta wędkarska, but still need the water permit.

extras.name: Water-user permit
extras.when: For the specific inland fishing district or water.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Marine recreational fishing uses a separate fee system. An inland water permit does not replace it; individuals must carry payment proof and identification.
keyRules: Use the inland permit only in its listed waters.
Follow the water manager's fishing rules.
Carry the marine fee receipt and identification when that fee applies.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy participating Polish Waters permits through WIR or the WIR app. Other managers issue their own permits.

sources.title: 2026 water permits and foreign visitor exemption

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current permit durations and fees with the water manager. Confirm marine payment details and charter-client requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Portugal

authority.name: ICNF and Directorate-General for Natural Resources, Safety and Maritime Services

jurisdictions.summary: Mainland freshwater and sea fishing use separate licences. Freshwater special fishing zones can also require a local permit in addition to the national, regional or non-resident licence.
whoNeedsOne: Non-resident freshwater anglers need the appropriate ICNF licence.
Marine anglers need the licence for shore, boat or underwater fishing, unless exempt.
exemptions: For marine fishing, children under 16 accompanied by a licensed angler do not need their own licence.

options.name: Mainland boat sea licence, includes shore

extras.name: Special freshwater-zone permit
extras.when: For ZPP or ZPL waters where the manager requires it, in addition to the basic freshwater licence.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The mainland sea licence is separate from freshwater. Boat, shore and underwater licence categories have different coverage.
keyRules: Carry the licence and required identity document.
Use the extra permit for the specific freshwater zone.
Observe marine minimum sizes and protected-species rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact ICNF for a non-resident freshwater licence. Foreign marine applicants can use BMar; allow five working days for normal processing.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: The prices shown are for mainland Portugal. Check Madeira and Azores rules, freshwater exemptions, and charter coverage separately.

jurisdictions.name: Romania

authority.name: National Agency for Fisheries and Aquaculture; Danube Delta Biosphere Reserve Administration

jurisdictions.summary: Recreational fishing in natural waters requires a named permit from the authority or the relevant fishing association. Check the water's manager; the Danube Delta has a separate fishing permit and visitor access permit.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in natural fishing waters need the permit issued for their activity and area.

extras.name: Association water permission
extras.when: For association-managed water, follow the association's approved permit and access procedure.

extras.name: Danube Delta recreational permit
extras.when: For recreational fishing in the reserve; valid with a visitor access permit.

extras.name: Danube Delta one-day visitor access
extras.when: For entry to the reserve unless an access-fee exemption applies.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Romania's fisheries law includes marine waters. Confirm the correct ANPA marine permit before sea fishing.
keyRules: Follow the approved rules for the water's manager.
Do not use natural bait for salmonids.
In the Danube Delta, hold both the fishing permit and the required visitor access permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the official ANPA permit portal or the relevant fishing association. Use the ARBDD portal for Danube Delta permits.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the current visitor procedure, permit fee and validity with ANPA. Check border-water approval and charter requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Serbia

authority.name: Ministry of Environmental Protection

jurisdictions.summary: A day or multi-day permit covers the issuing manager's waters. The ordinary annual permit has wider national coverage, but protected areas require their own permit.
whoNeedsOne: Recreational anglers need a permit unless the child exemption applies.
exemptions: Children under 14 may use one rod without a permit when accompanied by a permit holder.

extras.name: Protected-area fishing permit
extras.when: For the specific protected fishing area; the ordinary annual permit does not cover it.

keyRules: Keep the required catch record.
Return the catch record to the water manager at the end of the year.
Follow local restrictions on tackle and fishing areas.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy from the fishing-area user or the protected-area manager.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the visitor's documents, local sales channel and any distribution fee. Guide coverage is not confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Slovakia

authority.name: Slovensko.sk and municipal authorities

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers need both a municipal fishing card and a permit for the fishing ground. The inexpensive municipal card alone does not authorise access to a river or lake.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers need the fishing card and the water manager's fishing permit.
exemptions: Children under 15 are exempt from the municipal card fee, not from the card requirement.

extras.name: Fishing-ground permit
extras.when: For the chosen water, in addition to the municipal fishing card.

keyRules: Obtain both the card and the fishing-ground permit.
Return the permit with the completed catch record after use, as instructed by the issuer.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply for the card at a municipality. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-ground manager or the Slovak Fishing Union.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the water permit price, return deadline, visitor documents and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Slovenia

authority.name: SPOT government portal and fisheries authorities

jurisdictions.summary: Freshwater fishing requires a permit from the manager of the chosen water. At sea, ordinary shore angling is free, but recreational boat fishing requires a personal permit.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers need the local manager's fishing permit.
Recreational anglers who fish from a boat at sea need a marine permit.
exemptions: Recreational sea fishing from the shore does not require a permit.

extras.name: Freshwater water permit
extras.when: Obtain the permit for the fishing ground from its manager.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Shore fishing is permit-free. Boat anglers can use daily or weekly recreational marine permits.
keyRules: For an online marine permit, buy at least one hour before fishing.
Carry the marine permit; it cannot be transferred.
Do not use live vertebrates as marine bait.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain freshwater permits from the water manager. Marine recreational permits are available online through authorised issuers.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current permit prices, the official marine purchase link and guide-client requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Spain

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food; autonomous-community authorities

jurisdictions.summary: The autonomous communities issue fishing licences, with separate freshwater and sea systems. A freshwater licence does not replace a reserved-water permit, and an interregional licence covers only participating communities.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers need the applicable regional or interregional licence.
Marine anglers need the regional licence for their method; some species also require national authorisation.

extras.name: Reserved-water permit
extras.when: For controlled fishing grounds, such as Castilla y Leon cotos, in addition to the basic licence.

extras.name: Special marine-species authorisation
extras.when: For boat fishing targeting species covered by the ministry's special authorisation scheme.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Coastal communities issue shore, boat and underwater licences. The ministry also administers special-species authorisations and the PescaREC declaration system.
keyRules: Check that the licence covers your autonomous community.
Obtain the permit for a reserved freshwater fishing ground.
Declare the required marine catches, including releases, in PescaREC within 24 hours after the fishing activity.
The interregional licence covers Andalusia, Aragon, Castilla-La Mancha, Castilla y Leon, Madrid, Valencia, Extremadura, Galicia, Asturias and Murcia.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply through the chosen autonomous community's official licence service. Obtain reserved-water permits through its separate allocation or sales system.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm visitor identification requirements, local fishing-ground access and charter-client rules.

jurisdictions.name: Sweden

authority.name: County Administrative Boards and Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management

jurisdictions.summary: Ordinary hand-held rod fishing is free along the coast and in the five specified large lakes. Most other waters require the fishing-right holder's permit; public access to the land does not provide that fishing permission.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in other lakes, rivers and streams need the fishing-right holder's permission, usually a local fishing card.
exemptions: Hand-held tackle needs no fishing card along the coast or in Vänern, Vättern, Mälaren, Hjälmaren and Storsjön in Jämtland.
Foreign visitors have the same hand-held tackle rights as Swedish citizens.

extras.name: Local fishing card
extras.when: For water outside the free hand-held fishing areas, or permission directly from the fishing-right holder.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary hand-held rod fishing along the coast needs no fishing card. Species, gear, closed-area and reporting rules still apply.
keyRules: Check the area's rules in Svenska fiskeregler.
Do not use live fish as bait.
Do not fish in closed areas or during the applicable closed season.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain the local fishing card or permission from the fishing-right holder for the chosen water.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm local permit fees, sea catch-report duties, boat methods and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Switzerland

authority.name: Cantonal fisheries authorities; Canton of Bern

jurisdictions.summary: Fishing permissions depend on the canton and the chosen water. Check whether you need a cantonal permit or access through a leased fishery; a permit from one canton is not a national pass.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors must meet the permit and qualification requirements for the canton and water.
In Bern, non-residents can buy cantonal fishing permits.

extras.name: Leased-water permission
extras.when: For water where the fishing rights belong to a leaseholder, such as Zurich fishing districts.

keyRules: In Bern, permits for 30 days or longer require recognised fishing competence proof.
In Bern, short-permit anglers without that proof must read the official fish-welfare information.
Follow the permit's water boundaries and cantonal fishing rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the canton or fishery's permit service. Bern sells permits online, through Fischen Bern and through listed agents.

sources.title: Zurich fishing waters and fishing rights

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm fees, SaNa or foreign-qualification acceptance, free-fishing exceptions and guide requirements with the chosen canton.

jurisdictions.name: Turkey

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry

jurisdictions.summary: Foreign tourists may fish from the sea shore without an ordinary permit. Sea-boat and inland trips follow the licensed tourism-operator or provincial fishing-voucher route; shore freedom does not cover these trips.
whoNeedsOne: Foreign tourists who fish from a sea boat or in inland waters must follow the visitor authorisation route.
Foreign residents use the guest amateur fishing document.
Speargun users need the required diving-method fishing document from 1 January 2026.
exemptions: Foreign tourists can fish from the sea shore without an ordinary permit, subject to the method and conservation rules.

extras.name: Foreign-tourist fishing voucher
extras.when: For the provincial or district authorisation route for inland or sea-boat fishing.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The ordinary foreign-tourist shore exemption differs from boat fishing. Speargun use has a separate document requirement.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: The rules provide a route through operators with a commercial amateur fishing tourism permit. Confirm that the operator holds this permit for your trip.
keyRules: Do not use live fish as bait in inland waters.
Do not sell the recreational catch.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the provincial or district agriculture office for visitor documents, or use a licensed fishing-tourism operator.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm voucher duration, fees, local access and the documents required for the operator route.

jurisdictions.name: England & Wales

authority.name: Environment Agency

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 13 and above need a rod licence for salmon, trout, freshwater fish, smelt or eel. They also need the land or fishery owner's permission, including on private fishing lakes.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 13 and above who target the listed species in England, Wales or the Border Esk region.
The River Tweed is outside this licence system.
exemptions: Children under 13 need no rod licence.
Children aged 13–16 need a free junior licence.
A carer who does not fish needs no licence.

options.name: Trout and coarse, up to two rods
Trout and coarse, up to two rods
Trout and coarse, up to two rods

extras.name: Fishery or club permit
extras.when: Required permission for the chosen water, in addition to the rod licence.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Targeting salmon or sea trout requires the appropriate rod licence. Confirm the rules for other tidal species and locations.
keyRules: Show a valid rod licence when requested.
Observe the rod limits for the licence and species.
Submit the annual salmon and sea trout catch return even if you did not fish.
Follow national and local fishing byelaws.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy online through GOV.UK or call the Environment Agency licence service on 0344 800 5386.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the fishery ticket, local season and any guided-trip package.

jurisdictions.name: Scotland

authority.name: Scottish Government

jurisdictions.summary: Scotland generally has no national recreational rod licence, but freshwater anglers need permission from the fishing-right holder. The Border Esk region is an exception and uses the England and Wales rod licence as well.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers need the relevant fishery permit or written permission.
Anglers in the Border Esk must also meet the England and Wales rod licence rules.
exemptions: Outside the Border Esk exception, Scotland does not require a national recreational fishing licence.

extras.name: Fishery permit or written permission
extras.when: From the owner of the fishing rights for the chosen water.

keyRules: Do not fish for salmon with a rod on Sunday.
The brown trout closed season runs from 7 October to 14 March.
Check the owner of the fishing rights; the landowner can be a different person.
Follow the conditions of the fishery permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain permission from the fishery or fishing-right holder. The local fisheries board or trust can identify the correct contact.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm local prices, salmon closures, coastal permission and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Northern Ireland

authority.name: Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs and Loughs Agency

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers need a rod licence for the correct DAERA or Loughs Agency area and a separate water permit or day ticket. An England and Wales licence does not cover Northern Ireland.
whoNeedsOne: DAERA anglers aged 12 and above need the applicable rod licence.
Anglers of all ages need a licence in the Loughs Agency area.
exemptions: In the DAERA area, children under 12 do not need a rod licence. Water-permit conditions still apply.

extras.name: Water permit or day ticket
extras.when: For the chosen public, club or private fishery, in addition to the rod licence.

extras.name: DAERA/Loughs Agency endorsement
extras.when: To extend the relevant rod licence to both authorities' areas; water permission remains separate.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary sea angling needs no rod licence. Salmon and sea trout require a game rod licence.
keyRules: Use the licence for the correct authority's area.
Do not split a short-term licence across non-consecutive dates.
A DAERA game licence allows only one rod at a time.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy DAERA licences and public-water permits online or from distributors. Use the Loughs Agency eLicence service for its area.

sources.title: Rod licences and separate water permits
DAERA game licence ages and exemptions

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Check Loughs Agency prices, the specific water permit and guide arrangements.
